title: Single hieratic sign, London, British Museum, EA 10188 (AKU HT 69230)

object.name: London, British Museum, EA 10188
object.date: Argead (Macedonian) Period, Alexander IV, regnal year 12, Choiak
object.content: Ritualtext im Götterkult (Songs of Isis und Nephtyhs + Ritual of Bringing in Sokaris + Book of Overthrowing Apep, Names of Apep)

notes: AKU-PAL Hieratogramm (HT) 69230; AKU grapheme Z0100 (AKU GR 1460). Gold = the grapheme's MdC code(s) as given by AKU-PAL: Z2 (std). Möller numbers listed by AKU-PAL for this grapheme: 561.
